title: Nubbin-Regulated UDP-Glycosyltransferase NlUGT386G5 Mediates Quercetin Detoxification in the Brown Planthopper Nilaparvata Lugens.
authors: Yue, Lei; Gong, Jun; Zhou, Yaning; Kang, Kui
journal: Journal of agricultural and food chemistry
one_liner_zh: 该文研究褐飞虱中转录因子NlNubbin调控UDP-糖基转移酶NlUGT386G5介导槲皮素解毒的机制，虽涉及TF-DNA调控和分子对接/MD模拟，但核心是昆虫解毒代谢而非TF-DNA互作建模，方法仅作为辅助验证。
abstract: Quercetin is a defensive flavonoid that accumulates in rice following infestation by the brown planthopper (BPH), Nilaparvata lugens, but how BPH detoxifies quercetin remains unclear. Dietary quercetin reduced female survival and body weight in a dose-dependent manner. Transcriptomic analysis identified NlUGT386G5, which encodes a UDP-glycosyltransferase, as a quercetin-responsive candidate detoxification gene. Silencing NlUGT386G5 markedly increased BPH susceptibility to quercetin. Molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulations supported stable binding of quercetin to the NlUGT386G5 protein. Recombinant enzyme assays and LC-MS/MS showed that recombinant NlUGT386G5 converted quercetin into quercetin-3-O-glucoside, which did not significantly affect BPH survival or body weight. Promoter analysis and dual-luciferase assays identified the POU-domain transcription factor NlNubbin as a positive regulator of NlUGT386G5 transcription; NlNubbin knockdown reduced quercetin-induced NlUGT386G5 expression and tolerance to quercetin. Together, these results establish the NlNubbin-NlUGT386G5 pathway as a regulatory mechanism underlying quercetin detoxification and tolerance in BPH.
abstract_zh: 槲皮素是一种防御性黄酮类化合物，在水稻遭受褐飞虱（BPH）Nilaparvata lugens侵害后积累，但褐飞虱如何解毒槲皮素仍不清楚。饮食中的槲皮素以剂量依赖性方式降低了雌虫存活率和体重。转录组分析鉴定出NlUGT386G5，其编码一种UDP-糖基转移酶，作为槲皮素响应的候选解毒基因。沉默NlUGT386G5显著增加了褐飞虱对槲皮素的敏感性。分子对接和分子动力学模拟支持槲皮素与NlUGT386G5蛋白的稳定结合。重组酶测定和LC-MS/MS显示，重组NlUGT386G5将槲皮素转化为槲皮素-3-O-葡萄糖苷，该产物对褐飞虱存活率或体重无显著影响。启动子分析和双荧光素酶测定鉴定出POU结构域转录因子NlNubbin作为NlUGT386G5转录的正调控因子；NlNubbin敲低降低了槲皮素诱导的NlUGT386G5表达及对槲皮素的耐受性。综上，这些结果确立了NlNubbin-NlUGT386G5通路作为褐飞虱槲皮素解毒和耐受的调控机制。
